thread:
sana: dropping a micro-proto for stack frame interactions in the request drilldown. goal: make it easier to copy frames, export a compact text view, and keep the header tidy. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/stackframe-compact.png
jules: nice. two asks: (1) make "Copy frame" visible when a frame is focused, not only on hover; (2) offer a "View as text" that expands a plain-text block for easy paste.
omar: "View as text" is helpful for support. implement as a small toggle that reveals preformatted text. backend no-op. we should ensure it doesn't include PII by default.
lee: accessibility notes: the copy button must be a native <button> with aria-label="Copy stack frame". when copied, update an offscreen announcer: "Stack frame copied". avoid aria-live on the button itself.
sana: microcopy: label the toggle "View raw frame" and the copy tooltip "Copy stack frame". prefer explicitness over terse labels.
jules: UX polish: when copy happens, show ephemeral inline "Copied" for 1.6s and SR announce via announcer. also keyboard shortcut: press "f" to toggle raw frame when focus is inside the stack pane. document in shortcuts help.
omar: implementation detail: use navigator.clipboard with execCommand fallback. for raw text view, collapse long lines and allow select-all.
lee: focus management: when the raw view opens, focus should move into the pre element or the first actionable item inside it. add aria-expanded on the toggle.
a11y-bot: Reminder: run axe + keyboard walkthrough; ensure contrast and focus ring meet 3:1 for the inline buttons.
sana: next steps: I'll update the prototype with visible copy button on focus, raw-text toggle, announcer div, and shortcut. jules/omar/lee please review before Friday sync.
